mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome! I’m so glad you’re joining me on this journey where we’ll uncover the fascinating dance between intuition and logic—two forces that shape every decision we make, whether it’s something small or utterly life-changing. Now, imagine stepping into the world painted by Michael Lewis in The Undoing Project: A Friendship That Changed Our Minds. Together, we’ll follow the incredible partnership of Daniel Kahneman and Amos Tversky, two Israeli psychologists whose friendship didn’t just inspire groundbreaking discoveries—it actually changed how we all understand the way our minds work. You’ll discover how their remarkable collaboration peeled back the layers of human judgment, exposing how our choices are often colored by biases, gut feelings, and emotions—even when we think we’re being perfectly rational. As we explore their story, you’ll see how their insights sent shockwaves far beyond psychology, influencing everything from economics to medicine and even public policy. Through personal stories, surprising scientific revelations, and the evolution of a friendship that shaped the modern understanding of decision-making, we’ll get a front-row seat to the hidden forces that guide our thinking. So, let’s dive in together and discover just how beautifully complex—and unpredictable—our minds really are.
